decision: Close this fixed source-context KL repair operator. It loses to direct hybrid CE and ordinary merged-context teacher KL in both orders,and every leave-one-task-out contrast against those controls remains negative. mechanism_limit: The source-context objective constrains only the current shared residual at each original expert. It neither preserves the full merged function nor imposes an exact source-function constraint. A negative fixed recipe does not prove all source-preserving constructions impossible.
next_action: Select a distinct concrete merging operator using the accumulated failures and existing primary methods. Do not recycle the closed full-history,gradient-table,refresh or source-context-KL branches under new names; retain strong direct fitting controls and check whether an effect survives beyond the selected four-task subset.
